name: Intercom
description: Intercom is a customer service platform pairing a full helpdesk with Fin, a natively integrated AI agent, letting businesses handle both automated and human-led support conversations in one system.
best_for: Positioned for businesses modernizing customer support, claiming 30,000+ brands as customers, spanning small teams to enterprise organizations.
features: Fin AI Agent for automated customer inquiries
Copilot AI assistance for human agents
Omnichannel inbox (email, chat, phone, WhatsApp, social apps)

alternatives.name: Zendesk
alternatives.description: An AI-first service platform unifying ticketing, omnichannel messaging, and self-learning AI agents.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises and contact centers needing broad omnichannel and workforce-management tooling.

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: A customer service platform centralizing email and other channels into a shared inbox with AI drafting.
alternatives.best_for: Small-to-midsize support teams wanting a simpler, less complex helpdesk.
